description: Batch version of colour_passport. Submit up to 20 hex values in one call. Returns a full Colour Passport for each unique hex: colour science, archive anchor, evidence grade, do_not_say constraints, hex provenance, accessibility, and physics. Deduplicates hex values automatically. Use for multi-colour workflows, Figma palette analysis, or any case where calling colour_passport separately for each colour would be slow.

include_physics.description: Include illuminant behaviour and gamut data (default true)

n_archive.description: Number of archive matches per colour (default 3)

name: colour_passports

outputSchema.description: Returns ok, requested, unique, returned, errors, and results array of passports.

title: Batch Colour Passport Lookup
